title: Administration
legalDraftBody: Replace the bracketed fields in both languages and review the business terms before publishing. You can save the document as a draft while completing it.
deleteBody: The tour and its plans, sections and photographs will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
name: Name
uploadHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP. Maximum 5 MB. The first main gallery image is the cover.
whatsappHelp: Country code and number, without spaces or +.
emptyBody: Create the first one and complete translations before publishing.
unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave and discard them?
complete: To publish: complete both languages, an active plan with services, and a cover with a description.
confirmRemoveSection: Delete this section and its photographs? Save your changes to apply the deletion.
catalogBody: Control del catálogo, planes, traducciones y contenido de la Península de Nicoya.
mediaConvention: The first image is used as the tour cover. Use the arrows to change the order. Main-gallery photos appear in the tour detail; photos assigned to a section appear in that section gallery.
coverNotice: This image will be used as the tour cover on the home page, catalogue and tour detail.
uploadDrop: Drop the image to upload it
uploadFormats: JPG, PNG or WebP · Up to 5 MB · One image at a time
uploadLimit: You have reached the limit of 50 images
uploadNext: After uploading, add its Spanish and English descriptions and save your changes.
thumbnailProgress: Reviewing images: {{done}} of {{total}}. You can keep working; returning to the catalogue will resume processing.
thumbnailComplete: Images reviewed: {{count}}. WebP versions and thumbnails are used when they reduce file size.
thumbnailFailed: Some images could not be optimized. Original photos are still available.
thumbnailOriginals: Originals are kept as backups, along with image order, descriptions and the cover.
webpSavings: Main WebP versions created: {{count}}. Smaller downloads for these photos: {{kilobytes}} KB. Backups still use storage space.
